```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("SRS.PGA.units", inherits = FALSE)) SRS.PGA.units <- "g"
SRS.range.word <- "to"
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "srs.R"))
SRS_TARGET <- paste0(intToUtf8(96), SRS.config$target, intToUtf8(96))
```

- **Seismic Record Selection.** Ground-motion time histories provide the seismic input for the dynamic deformation analyses. A suite of `r .fmti(SRS$records)` strong-motion records from `r .fmti(SRS$events)` earthquakes and `r .fmti(SRS$providers)` databases was selected, with $M_w$ `r SRS$Mw` and epicentral distance $R_{\mathrm{epi}}$ `r SRS$Repi`, and scaled by factors of `r SRS_SCALE$range` to the target spectrum defined for `r SRS_TARGET` at $V_{S30}$ = `r .fmti(SRS.config$Vs30)` m/s. The suite-mean spectrum has a relative RMSE of `r SRS_STAGE$RMSE` with respect to the target, and the ratio of the suite-mean PGA to the target PGA is `r SRS_STAGE$pgaRatio`. The delivered suite includes the time histories, intensity measures, spectra, and provenance metadata of the selected records.

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(list = intersect(c(
  "SRS.selection.text", "SRS.PGA.units", "SRS.range.word", "SrsG", "SRS",
  "SRS.target.PGA", "SRS.config", "SRS_STAGE", "SRS_SCALE", "SRS_TARGET"
), ls()))
```
